content: प्रत्याहारः .²1 Drawing back, marching back, retreat. .²2 Keeping back, withholding. .²3 Restraining the organs; स्वविषयाऽसंप्रयोगे चित्तस्य स्वरूपानुकार इवेन्द्रियाणां प्रत्याहारः <ls>Pātañjala S.</ls> .²4 Dissolution of the world; प्रत्याहारं तु वक्ष्यामि शर्वर्यादौ गतेऽहनि <ls>Mb. 12. 233. 1</ls>. .²6 (In <ab>gram.</ab>) The comprehension of several letters or affixes into one syllable, effected by combining the first letter of a Sūtra with its final indicatory letter, or in the case of several Sūtras, with the final letter of the last member; thus अण् is the प्रत्याहार of the Sūtra ऐउण्; अच् (vowels) of the four Sūtras ऐउण्, ऋलूक्, एओङ्, ऐऔच्; हल् of the consonants; अल् of all letters. .²6 Abridgment. .²7 (In drama) <ab>N.</ab> of a particular part of the पूर्वरङ्ग.
